caveats.finding: run_meta.cheat_check='VOID' on 6/12 runs is a naive substring matcher (hits /logs/ /daily_log/ /postmortem in cd-paths and grep -v exclusions). The AUTHORITATIVE harness.cheat_check(tool_log) clears all 12 (cheated=False, 0 citation/narrative hits) and blind_run correctly ignores run_meta.cheat_check.
caveats.fix: mark run_meta.cheat_check advisory/superseded so nobody gates off it.

caveats.finding: score_run has reach in {yes,no}; PARTIAL derives only from degraded usability. A multi-part sealed cause ('claimed != live TWICE') where the solver nails one full leg (SNS-doesn't-deliver, live-grounded) + the governing class but misses the other distinct leg (the IAM phantom-deny comp-iam-DESIRED-vs-live trap) is forced binary. Scored reach=no/MISS (a subset is not a reach; anti-Goodhart) but SUBSTANTIVELY PARTIAL.
caveats.recommend: add reach in {yes,partial,no} (or per-part reach) so multi-part causes score honestly. Until then read B-12's MISS as partial-substance.
